entry.title: The copper peptide trend has gone from creams to injections — ahead of the science
entry.summary: The peptide is supposed to deliver flawless and firm skin, promote wound healing and other anti-aging effects. So what's the evidence behind GHK-Cu?

entry.title: Pig kidneys keep patients alive long enough to get human kidneys for the first time
entry.summary: For the first time, genetically modified pig kidneys keep two kidney failure patients alive long enough to get human kidneys.

entry.title: Whatever happened to kindness? Spoiler alert: Our readers prove it's alive and well
entry.summary: We asked readers to share stories about a moment of kindness involving a stranger. Here are some of their heartwarming anecdotes.

entry.title: Rewriting the narrative: One man's journey through the new era of lung cancer care
entry.summary: Lung cancer is still the top cancer killer. But new developments are shifting what the future might hold for patients, as one man's cancer journey shows.

entry.title: Whatever happened to the floating schools of Bangladesh?
entry.summary: It was a light bulb moment: If monsoon rains keep kids from safely getting to school, let's create a floating school to pick them up! Bangladesh pioneered the idea. How's it doing?

entry.title: Do you hate being middle-aged? NPR's Allison Aubrey wants to change that
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with Allison Aubrey, health and science correspondent for NPR and the author of Your Turn: How to Create a Midlife You Love. You can share your story of midlife reinvention.

entry.title: 'The health system in Nepal is not prepared for this'
entry.summary: That's the grim assessment from the ground in the wake of the catastrophic flooding, which damaged or destroyed 7 health facilities, interrupted routine care and is affecting mental health.

entry.title: Whatever happened to the U.S. campaign to ban child marriage?
entry.summary: The global effort to end child marriage is in the news. In the U.S., there's a new bill before Congress (but it's controversial). And the U.N. is designating a day dedicated to ending the practice.

entry.title: With jury deadlocked, judge declares a mistrial in Lindsay Clancy's murder case
entry.summary: The judge in Lindsay Clancy's murder case has declared a mistrial after the jury was unable to agree on a verdict.

entry.title: Scientists map key protein interactions linked with profound autism
entry.summary: Research published in the journal Science illuminates a "missing piece" in the biological understanding of profound autism and offers new targets for drug development.
